    Formula:
    f(x) =  0.5 * sum(x**2) + \
            0.2 * sum(np.sin(2*np.pi*x)) + \
            0.1 * sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i + 1, len(x))) + \
            0.05 * np.random.normal(0, 1) # Introduce noise to influence std and skewness
    """

        0.5 * np.sum(x**2) +
        0.2 * np.sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * x)) +
        0.1 * np.sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i + 1, len(x))) +
        0.05 * np.random.normal(0, 1) # Introduce noise to influence std and skewness
    )
